items.title: Live: Australian linked to ISIS blocked from returning home
items.description: The home affairs minister has temporarily blocked an Australian citizen linked to ISIS fighters from returning home from Syria. Follow live.

items.title: Chalmers's Lowe blow after ex-RBA governor offers rebuke of 'handouts'
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers says Philip Lowe was critical of the government over spending because it did not re-appoint him as RBA governor.

items.title: Mazda, Nissan and others face heavy penalties under emission laws
items.description: Major car brands are staring down the barrel of multi-million-dollar penalties for exceeding their emissions, the first results of the federal government's climate laws for new vehicles have revealed.

items.title: At Trump's first Gaza board meeting, another leader will be closely watched
items.description: Ahead of the inaugural meeting of US President Donald Trump's Board of Peace, charged with leading the way forward in Gaza, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto faces perhaps his most significant foreign policy test yet.

items.title: Millionaire economist's dire warning for Australian property market
items.description: British economist Gary Stevenson is on a speaking tour, warning Australia will follow the path of the UK with "poverty exploding" unless politicians deal with inequality.

items.title: What to know about the equal time rule Stephen Colbert says led to interview being pulled
items.description: The Late Show host Stephen Colbert's comments that network executives pulled his interview with a Democratic Texas Senate candidate have prompted a conversation about how US media outlets treat political coverage.

items.title: Rescuers race to save six skiers in California avalanche, 10 more missing
items.description: Rescue crews are battling blizzard conditions to reach the back-country skiers.

items.title: Glove found near Nancy Guthrie's home fails to produce DNA match
items.description: The glove resembled a pair worn by an armed man in a ski mask seen in video footage shortly before she was abducted.

items.title: A dead teenager, a TikTok brag track and a parent's dismissal of gang activity
items.description: Ater "Elia" Good was gunned down early this year, with police alleging it was a gang-related killing. His parents say their son was not a gang member but are aware activity is on the rise.

items.title: 'Australia must allow them in': Legal experts on the 'ISIS brides' dilemma
items.description: Australian families with links to Islamic State fighters should be returned to Australia to prevent harm and potential radicalisation of innocent children, according to United Nations special rapporteur Ben Saul.

items.title: Hanson issues partial apology for suggestion there are no 'good' Muslims
items.description: The One Nation leader qualified her earlier remarks, which had been met with condemnation, while reiterating calls for tougher vetting processes for Muslim migrants.

items.title: Sydney man jailed for antisemitic speech in bid 'to deter others'
items.description: Brandan Koschel is jailed after pleading guilty to inciting hatred on the grounds of race during an Australia Day protest in Sydney.

items.title: Who's to blame for Australia's T20 World Cup crash out?
items.description: For the first time since 2009, Australia won't advance from the group stage of a cricket World Cup and some of the game's greatest ever players are demanding answers.

items.title: Jesse Jackson helped lay the groundwork for America's first Black president
items.description: Reverend Jesse Jackson, who died on Tuesday aged 84, leaves behind a towering legacy in politics and the fight for justice in the United States and abroad.

items.title: Live: Health insurers surge ahead of premium hike, ASX rises
items.description: Shares of health insurers have surged ahead of premium hikes while the ASX has started its day higher, and NAB has reported a 30 per cent jump in quarterly profit. Follow live.

items.title: Catholic church can now be sued for paedophile priests' actions in Victoria
items.description: A bill reversing a High Court decision that found the Catholic Church could not be sued for the actions of a priest passes unopposed through Victoria's upper house.

items.title: What experts say about staying together for the children
items.description: When a relationships breaks down, sometimes we think staying in the familiar discomfort is less scary — and even protective — for our kids. But is it ever a good idea to stay in an unhappy relationship for the sake of the children?

items.title: The engineer trying to stop NASA's Artemis II launch going around the Moon
items.description: After years of delays, NASA's Artemis II mission is aiming to launch next month. But issues with the heat shield are causing some to raise the alarm.

items.title: $100k worth of cocaine, cannabis and cash seized in Whitsundays
items.description: Two people have been charged after police allegedly found drugs, utensils and cash at an Airlie Beach property.

items.title: Rape victim shares artwork amid plea to help solve historical case
items.description: A woman who was raped by two men in Melbourne's south-east in 1988 has spoken alongside police who are calling for public assistance to help solve the case.

items.title: One man dead, another in serious condition after Bruce Highway crash
items.description: Emergency services were called to the crash in Burpengary just after 10:30pm on Tuesday, where police said multiple vehicles were spotted travelling southbound in the northbound lanes.

items.title: Workers in cherry picker help police catch man accused of lewd acts
items.description: A man is accused of intimidation and carrying out a sexual act over incidents at a medical reception and childcare centre.

items.title: Melbourne man sets up West Gate Bridge livestream from his driveway
items.description: A man in Melbourne's west has set up a camera from his driveway to broadcast live vision of traffic on the West Gate Bridge, attracting thousands of views within weeks.

items.title: Council scraps four-day work week plan after backlash
items.description: A Tasmanian council's move to introduce a four-day work week, in part to attract and retain staff, has been abandoned after pushback by a business lobby group and what has been described as "unacceptable hostility" towards staff on social media.

items.title: Man who escaped mental health care facility fronts court over Sydney stabbings
items.description: A 25-year-old man police say stabbed a man to death in Merrylands days after fleeing from health authorities has been charged with murder.
